cast: THE FOUNDER HEAVEN ALLEGORY, a thesis on why hard work alone does not find this season's elevator: a jungle of opportunity under a floating protopian island, camouflaged space elevators with a few seats each (a takeoff window) before going dark forever, myths written by the people still on the ground, stories from above arriving smudged, and a prophet with a million followers whose broadcast lands after the seats are full. NEW: the-camouflaged-elevator (visual-metaphor, code-drawn elevation, master/camouflaged/ascending/defunct), founder-heaven (setting, establishing + terrace, silhouette elevation), the-jungle (setting, establishing + scale section), the-prophet (archetype character, never a named real person). REUSE: maya (the seeker who works harder than everyone; crossover: she is the visitor who walked through the door at the end of nobody-labeled-the-door), chrissy (the finder who tells her friends first; her locked voice IS the title), engineer (the plain-spoken circle member). Aim discipline: one island only, never two in a sky; the island never appears before its spread-02 reveal; smudged pages never carry readable letters; the prophet is warm and late, never a villain. Refrain: "Finders tell their friends."
